verdict.rationale: Lever documents its own recruitment analytics: shareable dashboards that track the metrics leaders care about, trend forecasting with rolling averages, and benchmarking against other talent teams. None of the specific funnel metrics the story names are evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit stage-conversion reporting, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness analysis, offer-accept rates, per-role/per-team breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team

citations.quote: Build, templatize, and share polished dashboards that track the metrics leaders care about—no manual reports, no guesswork.
Forecast and analyze trends, and track rolling averages with flexible, repeatable dashboards that make advanced reporting effortless.
Leverage insights from over 26,000 talent teams to see how your metrics stack up, and discover the actions that drive better results.
